capture_entry.caller_condition: Direct references to 0x802d33d0 in the ELF are at 0x802d38c0, 0x802d3a24, and 0x802d4124, all within StillCaptureHdrImageSave (0x802d35b0) or StillCaptureHdrRunProcessing (0x802d3b0c). This establishes an HDR route; a non-HDR normal-capture caller was not established.

code_go.condition: When **param3 is nonzero, the wrapper builds the code job, calls ApsJpegCreateCodeGo, then passes its returned handle directly to ApsJpegCreateCodeWait. When **param3 is zero, it uses param3[4] as the existing code size. There is no intervening nonzero-handle test at this callsite.
code_go.descriptor_mapping: The local ApsJpegCreateCodeGo context receives image descriptor=*param3, code buffer=param3[3], code-buffer capacity=param3[4], control field=0x7ff (semantics not assigned), and the descriptor handle from param3[2]. These are descriptor-level roles from argument construction; image-format semantics are not inferred.

path_setup.descriptor_fields: PathJpegSetCodeBuffer(path,buffer,capacity) ignores a null buffer; otherwise stores capacity at path+0x3ac, sets path+0x68 bit 0x08000000, and stores the buffer pointer at path+0x28. PathJpegSetImageBuffer selects path+8 when u16(path+0xb8)==1 and path+0x28 otherwise; with a non-null descriptor it copies words 0..6 to selected-object offsets 0..0x18 and sets path+0x68 bit 0.

completion_size.detail: Wait calls PathWait (0x801ca928), then reads PathGetCodeSize (0x801dea00, selector 0) as its return value; when its optional third argument is non-null it also stores PathGetCodeSize(path,1) through that pointer. If PathWait returns zero or the supplied capacity is less than the measured code size, it calls PathJpegCondense and rereads the size. The wrapper supplies param3[4] as capacity and null as the optional size-output pointer. PathGo is 0x801ca750.

path_execution.condition: The existing-path branch updates JPEG settings and image/code buffers; the alternative creates a path. Both reach the common submit/go sequence.

optional_auxiliary_encoding.condition: ApsExifCreateJpeg reaches this branch only when its param4-backed descriptor flags and non-null pointer checks set bit 0 of the local descriptor mask.
optional_auxiliary_encoding.observed_arguments: input pointer=*param4; destination=param7+header_offset; destination capacity=0xffec-header_offset; mode=3; dimensions are passed from param4[7] and param4[8]. The call's returned byte count is consumed locally.
optional_auxiliary_encoding.classification: Optional descriptor path. Evidence does not establish this buffer as the main captured image or as a thumbnail by itself.

partition_chunks.allocator_append: ApsFilePropPartitionAllocAndAdd at 0x802e3950 allocates a partition item, stores its data pointer at item+0x8 and byte size at item+0xc, then calls ApsFilePropPartitionAddObject at 0x802e38f8 to append it to the list rooted at partition+0x28.
partition_chunks.observed_callsite: ApsExifCreateJpeg calls ApsFilePropPartitionAllocAndAdd at 0x802c3cec after marker creation; additional branches allocate and append separate objects.
partition_chunks.boundary: The selected evidence connects the partition list to ApsSaveWrite and _fx_file_write when the StillServer-to-StoreOnSave success path is taken. The exact semantic identity of each partition item as main image versus auxiliary/metadata chunk is not fully assigned.

filesystem_boundary.detail: The observed path is StillCaptureSaveJpegImage -> ApsPipePost(pipe 0, 0x1005, context, 1) -> StillServer command 0x1005 -> StillOnFileReady(0x1002, same context and flag) -> ApsPipePost(pipe 3, 0x1002, same context and flag) -> StillStoreMain command 0x1002 -> StoreOnSave -> ApsSaveFile -> ApsSaveWrite -> ApsSaveWritePartitionObjectCB -> _fx_file_write. Each partition item is written from item+0x8 for item+0xc bytes. StoreOnSave requires HceCaptureStoreDcfDelay() != 0, mode query != 1, and StoreOnSaveGetResource (0x802b10ac) returning 0; ApsSaveFile also proceeds only when ApsSaveOpen (0x802e3c5c) returns 0. This is conditional static routing evidence; camera execution is not observed.
filesystem_boundary.additional_write: ApsSaveWrite also writes the separate tail/data region when its descriptor fields and count permit; callsite 0x802e4124 passes the computed source offset and size to _fx_file_write.

trace_limitations: Extents end at the next distinct sidecar address, not a typed ELF function size.
Linear MIPS32 word scan; edges are instruction candidates, not proof of reachability.
Delay slots are included in extents. Register-indirect targets are unresolved.
A jump is recorded as a transfer, not automatically a function call.
evidence_scope: Selected original instruction words and trace metadata are public; private C/ASM paths identify local review artifacts that are not redistributed. Trace extents use the next distinct sidecar address and do not assert a typed function boundary.
